findings.message: #bgm has data-volume="0.18" (-14.9 dB) and a GSAP tween on `volume`. Tween values are absolute: they REPLACE this gain rather than scale it, so wherever the tween names a value the clip plays at that value, not at -14.9 dB.
findings.fixHint: Write the tween's targets in the same absolute gain (e.g. `volume: 1.95`, not `volume: 1`), or reset data-volume to 1 and let the tween carry the level on its own.
